parameters: "Thank you for your help with the warehouse."
"Greetings.  I can tell you people are new to our town.  How may our town's administration be of service?  Are you here to help us with our warehouse?"
"Hi.  Um, warehouse?  We're just visiting, but we don't know anything about a warehouse.  What's up with that?"
"Our town's storage warehouse was recently over-run by monsters.  We don't know where they came from.  We've been hoping someone would
help us clean out the warehouse so we can use it again, as well as regain access to what we store there, but it has been a while and no
one in our town has stepped forward to help, even after we've offered a reward.  Are you willing to help us?"
1:  "Nah, we're just visiting town, but we might help later if you still need us then."
2:  "Reward?  How much are we talking about?"
3:  "Sure, we'll help.  When can we start?"
"Nah, we're just visiting town, but we might help later if you still need us then."
"I see.  Well, we'll be here.  Take care then."
"Reward?  How much are we talking about?"
\P[2] Looks a little disgusted at your sudden greed that is unlike yourself, then quickly turns away from you so you can't see her face.
The clerk forces a plastic smile.
"Oh, we'd be so happy to pay you for saving our town from this problem.  We can only spare so much, so we can't pay you as much as
we'd like, and we know you deserve more, but we'll give you 2,000\G in cash if you solve our problem with our warehouse."
You roll your eyes, then suddenly hope that \P[2] doesn't notice it.
"Um, okay, I guess we'll take it.  So how do we start?"
"Sure, we'll help.  When can we start?"
"You will?  Oh thank you, this saves our town!  I'm sorry that we don't have a lot of money to spare, and can only afford to reward you with
just a small percent of what you deserve, but we'll give you 2,000\G in cash for doing this, and honor your service for a long time afterwards.
"Hello.  I am Taro, the lead Samurai for the elder.  I will go with you to investigate the warehouse.
I sent some of my men in earlier and they did not come back.  I would send more with a much larger force, but it would weaken our town's forces too much
and also be unfair to my men.  We need to maintain a strong defense against the Golden Fox's forces."
"I will stick with you around town and into the warehouse, but not outside our island.  I will go with you anywhere within that to prepare
for dealing with the warehouse, if you wish."
"Returned to get back to investigating the warehouse?  Let me summon Taro.  One moment..."
"Returned to get back to investigating the warehouse?  Let me summon Taro.  One moment..."
